articles.title: Bank stocks lift indices ahead of RBI policy
articles.description: The Indian stock markets saw an upswing fueled by the performance of banking stocks amid falling oil prices. The Sensex and Nifty enjoyed substantial rises, as market participants eagerly anticipated the upcoming Reserve Bank of India monetary policy decision. Key players like Axis Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank reported strong quarterly figures, lifting investor mood.

articles.title: The Latest: Trump heads to Maryland in effort to tout factory investments amid economic fears
articles.description: President Donald Trump headed to Maryland to tout a $3.7 billion investment by Anduril in nuclear-powered submarines. The Trump administration aims to revive America’s shipbuilding capabilities for national security and economic reasons. This visit is part of a series of events showcasing factory investments, amid high gasoline prices and inflation affecting Trump’s approval ratings. With less than a month before the midterm elections, Trump is rallying support for his party. He has been traveling to deep red states like Oklahoma, Alabama, and Nebraska to boost Republican candidates.
